cd /opt/central && echo '' | base64 -d | xz -d > ops/platform-enable.py && chmod +x ops/platform-enable.py && python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('ops/platform-enable.py').read())" && echo '' | base64 -d | xz -d | docker exec -i central-stg-pg psql -U postgres -d central -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - && docker exec -i central-stg-pg psql -U postgres -d central -At -c "select 'MARKER:' || (pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) like '%p293_degrade%') from pg_proc p where p.proname='broker_report_connection'" && echo ----RLS && printf "BEGIN;\nSET LOCAL ROLE app_owner;\nSELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', t.tenant_id::text, true) FROM core.tenants t WHERE slug='isolation-canary';\nUPDATE core.tenants SET features = features || '{\"p293_probe\": false}'::jsonb WHERE slug='isolation-canary' RETURNING 'RLS_UPDATE_OK:' || slug;\nROLLBACK;\n" | docker exec -i central-stg-pg psql -U postgres -d central -At && echo APPLY293_OK
